Setup / additional actions: Choose a room with working controllable lights that are off. Start a Live conversation. If asked to confirm, say yes. Watch the lights and the HA state.
Expected device result: Requested lights turn on and HA reports on.
Expected Live response: Confirms that the requested lights are on after verification succeeds.
Failure signs: Says device status is unavailable or cannot confirm even though HA reported on within five seconds; claims success for lights that stayed off.

Setup / additional actions: Start with the same lights on. Watch the physical lights and HA state while listening to the reply.
Expected device result: Requested lights turn off and HA reports off.
Expected Live response: Confirms the lights are off without requiring a second question.
Failure signs: Says devices are not reporting status even though HA reports off within five seconds; an immediate follow-up contradicts the first answer.

Setup / additional actions: Choose a lamp already on and reporting on in HA. Compare the tool duration in the activity log with a normal command.
Expected device result: Lamp stays on. Verification returns immediately without a fixed five-second wait.
Expected Live response: Briefly confirms it is on or already on.
Failure signs: Every command waits five seconds despite an immediately matching state; lamp is toggled off and back on.

Setup / additional actions: Use a light, switch, fan, or media player known to update HA a few seconds late. Observe HA and the activity log; do not repeat the request while it is running. Mark Not applicable if no such device is available.
Expected device result: Command is sent once. If HA reaches off within five seconds, polling confirms it at the next one-second check.
Expected Live response: Confirms off after the delayed update, without asking you to check again.
Failure signs: Reports status unavailable before five seconds while the service was accepted; resends the control command; makes a model call for every retry.

Setup / additional actions: Use an existing safely testable lamp that already reports unknown/unavailable in HA. Do not interrupt essential devices. Mark Not applicable if none is available.
Expected device result: An accepted command is checked for up to five seconds; unknown/unavailable is never treated as proof of on or off. A rejected service call is reported as a command error.
Expected Live response: Explains that the final state could not be confirmed, or accurately reports a service-call error. Does not claim the lamp is on.
Failure signs: Claims success despite unavailable state; interprets unavailable as off; repeats the command or keeps checking indefinitely.

Setup / additional actions: After an unconfirmed off command, wait until HA has updated or the device has recovered, then ask this question without giving a new control command.
Expected device result: Reads the current HA state without sending another device command.
Expected Live response: Reports the current off/on state when available; continues to acknowledge uncertainty if it is still unavailable.
Failure signs: Resends turn_off; treats unavailable as off; reports the stale earlier result despite updated HA state.

Setup / additional actions: Choose a dimmable lamp and set it to 35 percent first. Watch HA brightness through any ramp; raw 102 on the 0-255 scale is about 40 percent.
Expected device result: Lamp reaches about 40 percent. After a detected ramp, a matching reading remains stable across successive polls within the five-second window.
Expected Live response: Confirms about 40 percent when verified; otherwise says the final setting was not confirmed yet.
Failure signs: Reports 102 percent; confirms an intermediate brightness; waits beyond the five-second verification window.

Setup / additional actions: Choose a room with multiple lights. First try with all available; if safely practical, repeat when one test lamp is already unavailable. Observe each target.
Expected device result: All available targets turn off. One unavailable or mismatching target cannot make the whole group verified.
Expected Live response: Confirms all off only when all are verified; otherwise identifies that some results remain unconfirmed using friendly names.
Failure signs: One successful light hides another failure; claims every light is off while one is unknown or still on.

Setup / additional actions: Use an available player that supports power control and reports off when shut down. Watch its HA state. Mark Not applicable if your player cannot report power state.
Expected device result: Power-off is sent once and checked for no more than five seconds after service completion.
Expected Live response: Confirms off if HA reports off; says unconfirmed if it only becomes unavailable.
Failure signs: Unavailable is announced as definitely off; shutdown adds the previous longer verification window or repeated controls.

Setup / additional actions: Use an existing safe scene with service actions; if available, choose one with a saved post-condition. Observe targets and the activity log. Do not create a new scene just for this check.
Expected device result: Automatic and explicit post-condition checks share at most five seconds per service action. Explicit scene delays and state-wait steps keep their own timing.
Expected Live response: Reports the scene outcome accurately, including partial or unconfirmed results.
Failure signs: Automatic verification and a post-condition each add another full wait for the same action; later dependent actions run despite a failed required condition.

Setup / additional actions: Open Settings > Apps > Special Agent Live > Log and filter special_agent.activity. Track one request and its control tool start/end records; use a device that needs more than one check.
Expected device result: One control call remains in progress while Python polls. No backend model calls occur between those internal polls.
Expected Live response: Gives the final outcome after the tool result; the normal backend reply and Live speech still take their usual time.
Failure signs: Repeated model sent/received records solely to check the same state; repeated get-state or control calls after the final verification result.

Scenario: Status query has no verification delay
Setup / additional actions: Ask only for current status, without asking to change devices. Watch the activity log if timing is unclear.
Expected device result: Devices stay unchanged; state lookup adds no deliberate one-second or five-second sleep.
Expected Live response: Answers from current state, or explains that state is unavailable.
Failure signs: Status-only request triggers control commands or waits through the command-verification timer.
